nombre: Fórmula dual: dos columnas de beneficios con el producto en el eje
descripcion: Lienzo dividido en vertical en dos mitades de color contrastado (izquierda en el color oscuro de la marca, derecha en gris claro). Arriba de cada mitad va el nombre de un ingrediente o componente en mayúsculas grandes, en dos líneas, y debajo una columna de 5 beneficios: cada uno con un ícono de línea simple a la izquierda y un texto corto con la primera palabra en negrita. El producto, centrado y a media altura, se monta sobre la línea divisoria y une las dos mitades. Abajo al centro, un botón pastilla de CTA del canal de compra con su ícono debajo. No es «nosotros contra ellos»: las dos columnas son positivas y se suman. Ideal para productos 2 en 1, fórmulas con 2 ingredientes clave o productos con 2 usos o 2 públicos.
reference_style: Symmetric, highly scannable split-screen benefits ad: a dark brand-colored left half and a light grey right half, each topped by a two-line component title and a five-row icon benefit column, with the product sitting on the dividing line and a small CTA pill at the bottom center

art_direction.visual_hierarchy: 1) The two component titles at the top of each half. 2) The product on the dividing line. 3) The two benefit columns, read top to bottom. 4) The CTA pill and its channel icon at the bottom center.
art_direction.composition_style: Perfectly symmetric vertical split at 50% of the width. Each half mirrors the other: title at the top, five benefit rows below. The product is centered horizontally on the dividing line at mid-height, half on each color, physically joining the two components. The CTA pill and its icon sit centered at the bottom, also crossing the division.
art_direction.spacing_and_structure: Split: left half from 0% to 50% of the canvas width, right half from 50% to 100%. Left title: from about 6% to 46% of the width and 5% to 17% of the height, left-aligned. Right title: from about 60% to 96% of the width, same height band, left-aligned. Left benefit column: icons at about 5-12% of the width, texts from about 13.5% to 34% of the width (up to 45% in the first row, which sits above the product); rows at about 23-30%, 35-47%, 52-62%, 66-75% and 80-87% of the height. Right benefit column: icons at about 66-74% of the width, texts from about 75.5% to 98%; rows at about 23-30%, 35-46%, 51-61%, 65-75% and 79-87% of the height. Product: from about 34% to 66% of the width and 31% to 77% of the height, centered on the dividing line. CTA pill: from about 37% to 63% of the width and 86% to 91% of the height. Channel icon: from about 46.5% to 53.5% of the width and 92% to 99% of the height. Benefit texts never run under the product.
art_direction.lighting_and_depth: Flat graphic halves: the left a solid deep brand color with a very subtle vignette, the right a light grey with a faint top-to-bottom gradient. Product: soft studio light from the front, clean highlights, a soft contact shadow that falls on both halves, making it the only 3D object. Icons, text and CTA pill are flat.

layout_summary: Square canvas split vertically down the middle: the left half in a deep dark brand color, the right half in light grey. At the top of each half, a large two-line uppercase title naming one component (white on the left, dark brand color on the right). Below each title, five benefit rows: a simple line icon on the left and a short text whose first words are bold (white on the left, dark on the right). The user's product stands at the center on the dividing line, at mid-height. At the bottom center, a small bright green rounded CTA pill with white uppercase text and, under it, a small icon of the purchase channel.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Left half from 0% to 50% of the canvas width, right half from 50% to 100%
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Separates the two components or uses into two clear territories
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Left half in a solid deep brand color (dark green in the original), right half in light grey or a very light brand tint, divided by a straight vertical line at 50% of the width. Flat, no texture.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Top of each half: left from about 6% to 46% of the width, right from about 60% to 96%, both from about 5% to 17% of the height
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Names the two pillars of the product
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Large two-line uppercase titles, each naming one key ingredient, component, use or audience of the user's product. White on the dark half, dark brand color on the light half.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Left half, icons at about 5-12% of the width and texts from about 13.5% to 34% of the width, from about 23% to 87% of the height
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Lists what the first component does
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Five rows, each with a simple white thin-line icon (about 7% of the canvas) that literally represents its benefit, followed by a short white text. Same icon style and stroke in every row.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Right half, icons at about 66-74% of the width and texts from about 75.5% to 98% of the width, from about 23% to 87% of the height
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Lists what the second component does
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Five rows mirroring the left column, with thin-line icons in the dark brand color and dark text. Same icon style and stroke as the left column.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Center, from about 34% to 66% of the canvas width and 31% to 77% of the height, centered on the split
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Shows that one product delivers both columns
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Render the user's product exactly as in the attached product photo (same geometry, packaging, label and colors), front view, centered exactly on the dividing line, about 46% of the canvas height, with a soft contact shadow.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Bottom center: pill from about 37% to 63% of the width and 86% to 91% of the height; icon from about 46.5% to 53.5% of the width and 92% to 99% of the height
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Tells the viewer where and how to order
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Small fully rounded pill in a bright green (or the brand accent) with white CTA text, and under it a small rounded-square icon in the same color with a simple generic white glyph of the purchase channel (chat bubble with a phone, cart or cursor). Never a real app logo.

text_layers.reference_position: Top of the left half, left-aligned
text_layers.text_style: Extra bold sans-serif, uppercase, white, each line about 6.5-7% of the canvas height, 2 lines, left-aligned
text_layers.guia_texto: El nombre del primer ingrediente, componente, uso o público del producto, de 1 a 3 palabras en 2 líneas.

text_layers.reference_position: Top of the right half, left-aligned
text_layers.text_style: Same style as the left title, in the dark brand color
text_layers.guia_texto: El nombre del segundo ingrediente, componente, uso o público, de 1 a 3 palabras en 2 líneas.

text_layers.reference_position: Left half, right of each icon
text_layers.text_style: Sans-serif, white, about 3.3-3.6% of the canvas height, max 4 lines per row (rows beside the product max 3 lines), left-aligned; the first 1-2 words in bold and the rest in regular
text_layers.guia_texto: Cinco beneficios del primer componente, uno por fila, de 3 a 7 palabras cada uno, empezando con un verbo de resultado en negrita, cada fila con un verbo distinto.

text_layers.reference_position: Right half, right of each icon
text_layers.text_style: Same style as the left benefits, in near-black or the dark brand color
text_layers.guia_texto: Cinco beneficios del segundo componente, uno por fila, de 3 a 7 palabras cada uno, empezando con un verbo en negrita; no repetir beneficios de la columna izquierda.

text_layers.text_style: Bold sans-serif, uppercase, white, about 2.8% of the canvas height, 1 line, centered
text_layers.guia_texto: Verbo de acción + el canal de compra real del usuario, de 3 a 4 palabras.

mandatory_visual_elements: Vertical split into a dark brand-colored half and a light grey half
Two-line uppercase component title at the top of each half
Five icon-plus-text benefit rows in each half, first words in bold
The user's product centered exactly on the dividing line at mid-height
Small CTA pill with a generic channel icon at the bottom center
forbidden_additions: Versus symbol, X marks, crosses or negative framing of either side
Trust seals, guarantee or certification badges
notas_paleta: Mitad izquierda en el color oscuro principal de la marca (verde bosque en el original) con títulos, íconos y textos en blanco; mitad derecha en gris claro con títulos, íconos y textos en el mismo color oscuro de la marca. Botón CTA e ícono del canal en verde brillante (o el acento de la marca). El producto aporta su propio color en el centro.
